title_en: The Adventure Time Deluxe Comics Library Gathers 15 Years of Comics in One Algebraic Package
summary_en: If you're a hardcore Adventure Time fan, then you'll want to own this massive, six-volume collection of every Adventure Time comic from the past 15 years.
body_en:
Oni Press is celebrating 15 years' worth of Adventure Time comics with a new collection called Adventure Time Deluxe Comics Library. This massive six-volume set gathers everything published by BOOM! Studios and Oni Press since 2012, making it ideal for hardcore fans of the franchise.
With the Kickstarter campaign for the Adventure Time Deluxe Comics Library now live, IGN can exclusively debut a preview of Ryan North and Jim Rugg's Adventure Time #26, one of the many comics collected within. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
The Adventure Time Deluxe Comics Library includes content from the following creators, among many others:
The Kickstarter campaign gives collectors a number of different options. They can purchase individual volumes or the entire six-book set. There are also two exclusive, limited edition bundles - the Land of Ooo boxset and the Land of BMO boxset.
“The algebraic ADVENTURE TIME DELUXE COMICS LIBRARY slipcase editions are entirely Kickstarter exclusive and will never be made available in mass quantities anywhere else,” said Oni Press Director of Business Development Sam Kusek in a statement. “This campaign is a celebration of the comic adventures of Finn, Jake, Princess Bubblegum, Marceline… the list goes on and on—and also includes a limited edition land of Ooo boxset and an even more limited edition BMO boxset! No matter who your favorite Adventure Time character is, there’s something for everyone.”
In other Adventure Time news, IGN recently debuted the trailer and poster for Adventure Time Side Quests Season 2 . Produced by Cartoon Network Studios, all episodes Adventure Time: Side Quests Season Two will be available to stream on October 2 on Disney+ and Hulu. The first two episodes debuted at IGN Live this past June.
